structuralInventory.deduplication: Buffer IDs are global within each page and were deduplicated across named owners. Ordinary-array lengths are path observations; backing capacity and cross-owner ordinary-array identity are unavailable. Do not sum per-owner aliased frame buffers as independent memory.
structuralInventory.steadyTopology: Every ready/start/end snapshot has one loop and one animate rAF pending; no preview tick remains. Existing 250 ms and 500 ms intervals remain, with a 15 s request timeout when sky refresh is pending. No observed listener/worker/canvas construction or canvas resize increments from ready through end.
structuralInventory.ownerValidity: All named owners have exactly one registration and untruncated successful inventories. Moon worker identity, serial, and message totals are unchanged across ready/start/end in all 16 slots. Native sky refresh starts/accepts 1-2 jobs in individual measured windows and can be pending at boundaries; it was not drained or disabled.
structuralInventory.providerObservation: Each page records four initial provider fetch attempts, four first responses, zero cached-response hits and zero pending at ready/start/end. Provider counters do not measure every source function early return before fetch. No new external value/acquisition occurred; original native scheduling remained active.
structuralInventory.workerScope: Window adapter observes two workers (Moon coordinator and sky). Pinned source constructs two nested lunar row workers in A and four in B; their heaps/callbacks/allocations are outside this probe. Two observed workers is not a total-worker claim.
structuralInventory.disposal: Actual optional-owner dispose terminates both window-owned workers, removes its timers and two listeners, clears current Moon/detail/sky buffers, and leaves main loop plus 9 A/12 B listeners until context close. B initial-Moon cache remains 19,594,660 bytes plus ordinary rule arrays. Context/browser/Playwright shutdown and recorded owned-process cleanup are separate verified endpoints; no GC reclamation observation.
structuralInventory.limits: Known retained buffers remain stable in size but some frame buffer identities change with refresh. This is not allocation freedom, absence of per-frame temporary objects, whole-heap/native/GPU memory, nested-worker memory, long-lived growth, or leak/reclamation proof. The recorder itself reserves 11,202,688 bytes per page plus observer metadata, excluded from product totals.
